title: RESKit synthetic test fixtures
description: Fixtures invented here, with no upstream at all: a rectangle that is exactly one MERRA-2 grid cell, 100 randomly placed turbines, and two turbine cost baselines.

sources.title: RESKit - Renewable Energy Simulation toolkit for Python

ALL FILES IN THIS DATASET HAVE BEEN MODIFIED: every one is a spatial and/or temporal subset of the product named in its member descriptor, and several have been resampled. None is suitable for any purpose other than exercising RESKit's code paths.
